say:0:1012615001:0.text: Lyca, you don't look good. Do you need some rest?
say:0:1012615001:0.source_cn: 莱卡……你的脸色不太好哦，要不要休息一会儿？

say:0:1012616001:0.text: More gruglins... I never want to see them ever again.
say:0:1012616001:0.source_cn: 又是咕布林……我可再也不想见到它们了。

say:1:1012618002:0.text: It's a minor wound. Nothing to worry about. We need to go after Eomir.
say:1:1012618002:0.source_cn: 小伤，不碍事。还是追击伊米尔要紧。

say:0:1012619001:0.text: Let's make camp over and rest for now. I'm a little tired.
say:0:1012619001:0.source_cn: 那边有一片空地，今天暂时扎营休息吧。我有些累了。

say:2:1012619003:0.text: I'm tired also, but I didn't expect you two to complain.
say:2:1012619003:0.source_cn: 虽然我也筋疲力尽了……但真没想到，居然是你们两个先喊累。

say:2:1012621001:1.text: I am not surprised that Lorsan overslept. However, Eironn, what's wrong with you today? Did you accidentally eat some weird fruit last night?
say:2:1012621001:1.source_cn: 洛桑赖床，我毫不意外。可是埃隆，你是怎么回事？难道你昨...

say:3:1012621002:1.text: There are dark circles under your eyes. Did you stay up all night?
say:3:1012621002:1.source_cn: 看你这黑眼圈，又像是熬了夜。

say:5:1012621004:1.text: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?
say:5:1012621004:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，您怎么在偷笑？您好像知道些什么……他们两个昨...
say:5:1012621004:1.male: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?
say:5:1012621004:1.female: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?

choice_prompt:6:1012621004.text: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?
choice_prompt:6:1012621004.source_cn: 梅林大人，您怎么在偷笑？您好像知道些什么……他们两个昨晚该不是擅自行动了？
choice_prompt:6:1012621004.male: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?
choice_prompt:6:1012621004.female: Why are you laughing, Magister? You know something, don't you? Did they do something they weren't supposed to do?

say:7:1012621005:1.text: Alright, I'll respect their privacy. From the looks of it, it's not something disastrous, at least.
say:7:1012621005:1.source_cn: 好吧，我尊重每个人的秘密。看他们的样子，应该不是什么坏事。
say:7:1012621005:1.male: Alright, I'll respect their privacy. From the looks of it, it's not something disastrous, at least.
say:7:1012621005:1.female: Alright, I'll respect their privacy. From the looks of it, it's not something disastrous, at least.

say:8:1012621008:0.text: *Sigh*... After a peaceful night's rest, my body feels much better. Thank you, Eironn.
say:8:1012621008:0.source_cn: 呼……安稳地休息了一夜，我的身体感到轻松不少。埃隆，谢谢你。

say:10:1012621010:0.text: You were the one who offered to rest yesterday, but you've always been tireless since we were young. You said that because you were afraid I was pushing myself too hard.
say:10:1012621010:0.source_cn: 昨天是你主动提出要休息，可你的体力一向很好，你是怕我逞...

say:11:1012621011:1.text: Your skills with the bow are indispensable on our journey, we need you in top form.
say:11:1012621011:1.source_cn: 这一趟旅途，少不了你精准的弓箭。

say:12:1012621012:1.text: Alright... Let's go then! There are people waiting for us. Let's capture Eomir and return to the Dark Forest!
say:12:1012621012:1.source_cn: 嗯……出发吧！还有人在等着我们。抓住伊米尔，把好消息带...

say:14:1012621006:1.text: Really? Your eyes can't deceive me. There's a secret here, but I won't ask questions this time.
say:14:1012621006:1.source_cn: 真的吗？您的眼神可骗不了我，一定有什么秘密。这次我就不...
say:14:1012621006:1.male: Really? Your eyes can't deceive me. There's a secret here, but I won't ask questions this time.
say:14:1012621006:1.female: Really? Your eyes can't deceive me. There's a secret here, but I won't ask questions this time.

say:15:1012621007:1.text: So mysterious... Well, I am looking forward to it.
say:15:1012621007:1.source_cn: 这么神秘啊……好，我会期待的。
say:15:1012621007:1.male: So mysterious... Well, I am looking forward to it.
say:15:1012621007:1.female: So mysterious... Well, I am looking forward to it.

say:3:1012701002:0.text: Silence! I am the only one who is fit to lead the Dark Forest! Who are you to talk to me this way?!
say:3:1012701002:0.source_cn: 住口！我才是有资格号令薄暮丛林的人！而你算什么东西……...

say:4:1012701003:0.text: My only crime was being born at the wrong time. It is you who do not deserve to lead! As long as I have the power of the Dark Forest... <style="highlight">I will live forever</style>!
say:4:1012701003:0.source_cn: 我生不逢时……才让你钻了空子！然而只要拥有薄暮丛林的力...

say:7:1012701004:0.text: The life force of the forest does not belong to you! All the leaves will eventually wither! Face your fate!
say:7:1012701004:0.source_cn: 丛林的生命力不属于你，所有的叶子终将枯萎，面对你的命运吧！

say:8:1012701005:0.text: Hold your tongue! Dahnie and Arden are destined to perish and fall to the earth! But I will not!
say:8:1012701005:0.source_cn: 闭上你的嘴！烂在土里是达赫妮跟雅顿的命运！不是我！

say:10:1012701006:0.text: You are a goat-kissing fool, Eomir!
say:10:1012701006:0.source_cn: 你简直是一颗彻头彻尾的臭豆子！伊米尔！

say:16:1012701008:0.text: *Laugh*... It seems like we old-timers have finally caught up!
say:16:1012701008:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵……看来我们这两把老骨头赶上了。

say:18:1012701010:0.text: Speak for yourself, Arden! I'm still a spring chicken compared to you.
say:18:1012701010:0.source_cn: 雅顿，只有你是老骨头！我可不是！

say:19:1012701011:0.text: Eomir! You joined forces with grove killers and desecrated our sacred tree for your own self-serving ends! I shall carry out Misarte's will on this day and mete out justice with my own hands!
say:19:1012701011:0.source_cn: 伊米尔！你为了一己私欲竟然与恶人勾结，亵渎圣树！今天我...

say:20:1012701012:0.text: *Laugh*... It's been a while since anything has set my blood on fire. I think it is also time for me to stretch my muscles a bit. Be prepared, Eomir!
say:20:1012701012:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵呵，久违的热血沸腾。好！我也来稍微动动筋骨。伊米...

say:2:1012702001:0.text: Eomir! Confess your guilt, and we'll show mercy! Things do not have to end this way!
say:2:1012702001:0.source_cn: 伊米尔！你的脑子清醒了没有！早点低头认罪，我们还愿意赏...

say:3:1012702002:0.text:
Curse you all!
Shut up, you old hag!
say:3:1012702002:0.source_cn: 可恶……可恶！可恶！\n你这老太婆，不要口出狂言！

say:4:1012702003:0.text: My destiny does not end here! You two have not defeated me! I cannot be defeated!
say:4:1012702003:0.source_cn: 我的命运不会在此终结！你们没有打败我……你们两个！不可...

say:7:1012702005:0.text: Light-blasted fool... What are you all standing around for? Go after him!
say:7:1012702005:0.source_cn: 混蛋……都愣着干什么？还不快追！

say:5:1012704001:0.text: You promised more power! I need it now! I must defeat these worms!
say:5:1012704001:0.source_cn: 快！你答应过，要给我力量！我一定要打败那些混蛋！

say:6:1012704002:0.text: You seem to think I owe you something, but our deal is already over.
say:6:1012704002:0.source_cn: 说得像是我亏欠你似的，这明明是我们的交易。

say:7:1012704003:0.text: However, since our deal was so favorable to me, I'll grant you your wish.
say:7:1012704003:0.source_cn: 看在我有所收获的份上……好吧，我可以实现你的愿望。

narration:9:1012724:0.text: The woman who disappeared in Slopeville reappears, and Eomir begins another dispute with her.
narration:9:1012724:0.source_cn: 在南坡村消失的那位女士再次出现，伊米尔又一次和她产生了争执。

say:0:1012705001:0.text: He's escaped again! He just doesn't stop!
say:0:1012705001:0.source_cn: 又跑了！那家伙真是顽强啊！

say:1:1012705002:0.text: He's able to resurrect himself... like the corrupted roots from before.
say:1:1012705002:0.source_cn: 他获得了复生的力量……就像先前那些除不掉的腐化根茎。

say:2:1012705003:0.text: So, how do we defeat Eomir?
say:2:1012705003:0.source_cn: 那我们要怎样打败现在的伊米尔？

say:3:1012706002:0.text: I can no longer sense Eomir.
say:3:1012706002:0.source_cn: 起码，我已经彻底感受不到伊米尔的气息了。

say:8:1012706003:0.text: That stupid fool... No one escapes Misarte's will.
say:8:1012706003:0.source_cn: 愚蠢的男人，最终还是没能逃过弥萨忒的制裁。

say:9:1012706004:0.text: The life force stolen by Eomir has been absorbed into the Sylvan Egg. As long as it is brought back to the Lucent Tree, its powers will be returned.
say:9:1012706004:0.source_cn: 伊米尔夺走的生命力已经被翡绿之卵尽数吸收。只要把翡绿之...

say:13:1012706006:0.text: Master Arden, shouldn't you be a little bit happier at a time like this?
say:13:1012706006:0.source_cn: 我说雅顿老师，这时候不再高兴一点吗？

say:14:1012706007:0.text:
Yahoo! It's finally over!
See? That's how you celebrate. This is the best time for you to compose one of your poems.

say:19:1012706008:0.text: It's not over yet! Where did that blue-haired woman go?!
say:19:1012706008:0.source_cn: 还没完呢！那个蓝头发的女人跑哪去了？！

say:20:1012706009:0.text: While we were occupied with Eomir, she used magic to escape.
say:20:1012706009:0.source_cn: 在伊米尔倒下之前，她趁我们无暇顾及，用魔法逃走了。

say:21:1012706010:0.text: Curses... If she attempts to harm our forest again, I'll chop her into pieces!
say:21:1012706010:0.source_cn: 该死的家伙……她要是再敢打丛林的主意，我非得将她大卸八块！

say:24:1012706011:0.text: *Chuckle*... Dahnie, the children have become stronger. That woman would not dare to come back again.
say:24:1012706011:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵……达赫妮，经此一役，孩子们都变得强大了不少，那...

say:27:1012706012:0.text: Eironn, look at the sword in your hand. I can feel the power of Misarte in that blade... This is proof that Misarte recognizes you as one of her own.
say:27:1012706012:0.source_cn: 埃隆，看看你手中的剑，我能从中感知到弥萨忒的力量……毫...

say:29:1012706014:0.text: I heard Misarte's call, and she guided me on what I must do. But the moment I drew my sword, I realized I couldn't have gotten this far on my own.
say:29:1012706014:0.source_cn: 那时候，我仿佛听到了弥萨忒的呼唤，祂指引着我该做什么。...

say:30:1012706015:0.text: I can't guarantee that I will always be strong. But I believe that even if I end up lost once more, <style="highlight">my companions will lead me back to the light.</style>
say:30:1012706015:0.source_cn: 我无法保证自己能够永远坚定。但我相信，就算我再度陷入迷...

say:31:1012706016:0.text: This is the answer I have found.
say:31:1012706016:0.source_cn: 这是现在的我，给出的答案。

say:32:1012706017:0.text: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.
say:32:1012706017:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵……梅林，这孩子跟着你，成长了许多啊。
say:32:1012706017:0.male: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.
say:32:1012706017:0.female: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.

choice_prompt:33:1012706017.text: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.
choice_prompt:33:1012706017.source_cn: 噢呵呵……梅林，这孩子跟着你，成长了许多啊。
choice_prompt:33:1012706017.male: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.
choice_prompt:33:1012706017.female: *Laugh*... Magister Merlin, this child has grown a lot traveling with you.

say:34:1012706018:0.text: *Laugh*... I need more from your candor. You live, and you learn.
say:34:1012706018:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵！你那份幽默的坦然，我要好好学习一番。寿命不止，...
say:34:1012706018:0.male: *Laugh*... I need more from your candor. You live, and you learn.
say:34:1012706018:0.female: *Laugh*... I need more from your candor. You live, and you learn.

say:37:1012706020:0.text: Alright, let's save all the talk until we're back in the Dark Forest. The Lucent Tree is still waiting for our return.
say:37:1012706020:0.source_cn: 好了好了，有什么话等回到薄暮丛林再说。流荧树还在等着我...

say:39:1012706019:0.text: *Laugh*... I will tell all our children that the current Magister Merlin is a humble mage.
say:39:1012706019:0.source_cn: 噢呵呵！以后讲课时我会告诉孩子们，现任梅林是个谦虚的魔法师。
say:39:1012706019:0.male: *Laugh*... I will tell all our children that the current Magister Merlin is a humble mage.
say:39:1012706019:0.female: *Laugh*... I will tell all our children that the current Magister Merlin is a humble mage.

say:1:1012707001:1.text: Magister Merlin, we were waiting for you. Everyone agreed that without you, this ceremony would be incomplete.
say:1:1012707001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们在等你。大家一致认为，如果没有你，这场仪...
say:1:1012707001:1.male: Magister Merlin, we were waiting for you. Everyone agreed that without you, this ceremony would be incomplete.
say:1:1012707001:1.female: Magister Merlin, we were waiting for you. Everyone agreed that without you, this ceremony would be incomplete.

say:2:1012707002:1.text: Without your guidance and leadership, we would not have been able to defeat Eomir. Therefore, we would like to ask you to witness this moment.
say:2:1012707002:1.source_cn: 若不是有你的跟随和教导，我们不可能打败伊米尔。因此，我...
say:2:1012707002:1.male: Without your guidance and leadership, we would not have been able to defeat Eomir. Therefore, we would like to ask you to witness this moment.
say:2:1012707002:1.female: Without your guidance and leadership, we would not have been able to defeat Eomir. Therefore, we would like to ask you to witness this moment.

say:3:1012707003:1.text: I am going to return the life force that Eomir stole from the Dark Forest. We will forever be grateful for your contribution and assistance in our time of need.
say:3:1012707003:1.source_cn: 那么，我要将伊米尔夺取的生命力归还给丛林了，我们将永远...
say:3:1012707003:1.male: I am going to return the life force that Eomir stole from the Dark Forest. We will forever be grateful for your contribution and assistance in our time of need.
say:3:1012707003:1.female: I am going to return the life force that Eomir stole from the Dark Forest. We will forever be grateful for your contribution and assistance in our time of need.

say:4:1012707004:1.text: Regardless of Esperia and its future, your deeds will be sung in these parts for generations to come.
say:4:1012707004:1.source_cn: 无论伊索米亚的命运如何流转，这片丛林都将世代传颂你的事迹。
say:4:1012707004:1.male: Regardless of Esperia and its future, your deeds will be sung in these parts for generations to come.
say:4:1012707004:1.female: Regardless of Esperia and its future, your deeds will be sung in these parts for generations to come.

say:5:1012707005:1.text: The Dark Forest is forever grateful to you, Magister Merlin.
say:5:1012707005:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林永远感谢你，梅林大人。
say:5:1012707005:1.male: The Dark Forest is forever grateful to you, Magister Merlin.
say:5:1012707005:1.female: The Dark Forest is forever grateful to you, Magister Merlin.

say:1:1012708001:0.text: My back made a cracking sound like rotting wood just now... *Sigh*... I hope it won't suddenly give out on me.
say:1:1012708001:0.source_cn: 我的腰发出了朽木般的咔咔声……唉，真不知道这老腰会不会...

say:2:1012708002:0.text: Arden, that old rascal, isn't much better. As he's gotten older, his body isn't as spry as it used to be.
say:2:1012708002:0.source_cn: 雅顿那老家伙也没好到哪去，一旦上了年纪，这身子骨实在是...

say:3:1012708003:0.text: After the battle with Eomir, Arden and I both need to recover from our injuries. The council of elders cannot currently govern.
say:3:1012708003:0.source_cn: 伊米尔做出了那种事，雅顿和我又都需要养伤。三贤共治暂时...

say:4:1012708004:0.text: According to the ancient rites in the Dark Forest, when the three elders cannot perform their duties, the Scion of the Lucent Tree shall handle all matters until the elders return.
say:4:1012708004:0.source_cn: 根据薄暮丛林的古老契约，三贤缺位时，将由流荧树之子代管...

say:5:1012708005:0.text: From now on, you will be very busy, Eironn.
say:5:1012708005:0.source_cn: 埃隆，接下来你会很忙，可不能松懈啊。

say:7:1012708006:0.text: Regarding this matter, I would like to discuss it with you, Lyca.
say:7:1012708006:0.source_cn: 关于这件事，莱卡，我想和你好好商量。

say:10:1012708007:0.text: To tell you the truth, I've decided to travel the world to pursue the path of the sword. I wish to hone my skills to the pinnacle of swordsmanship.
say:10:1012708007:0.source_cn: 实不相瞒，我决定继续磨砺剑术。为了追寻至高的剑道，我还...

say:11:1012708008:0.text: Unlike you, I do not have the power to unite the Wilders.
say:11:1012708008:0.source_cn: 我不像你，除了敏锐的洞察力，还有能够让大家团结一心的力量。

say:12:1012708009:0.text: I may be able to stop the disputes, but you have the power to prevent them altogether.
say:12:1012708009:0.source_cn: 如果说我能平定纷争，那你甚至可以将纷争消灭于萌芽时。

say:13:1012708010:0.text: I've thought this through. Only by holding this sword can I protect all who dwell in the forest. My sword exists to cut through the darkness in times of strife.
say:13:1012708010:0.source_cn: 我已经想清楚了。只有握紧了剑，我才能保护大家。我的剑，...

say:14:1012708011:0.text: And you, Lyca, are the one who wanders the night and brings dawn to these lands.
say:14:1012708011:0.source_cn: 而你，莱卡，你才是巡游于薄暮之时，最终为丛林带来拂晓的人。

say:15:1012708012:0.text: What the Dark Forest needs now is you, not me.
say:15:1012708012:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林此时此刻需要的是你，而不是我。

say:16:1012708013:0.text: What do you think, Lyca? I don't want to force this decision upon you. Your own thoughts are what matters.
say:16:1012708013:0.source_cn: 莱卡，你怎么想？我不想将这一切强加于你，我尊重你的想法。

say:17:1012708014:0.text: If you had asked me when this journey began, my answer would have been an emphatic "no". However, after all that we've been through, I'll acquiesce.
say:17:1012708014:0.source_cn: ……假如，你在这趟旅行开始前问我，我一定会拒绝。但现在...

say:18:1012708015:0.text: Being a Dusk Patroller, I want to preserve the peace of the Dark Forest forever.
say:18:1012708015:0.source_cn: 身为薄暮巡游者，我愿永远守护丛林的宁静。

choice_prompt:19:1012708015.text: Being a Dusk Patroller, I want to preserve the peace of the Dark Forest forever.
choice_prompt:19:1012708015.source_cn: 身为薄暮巡游者，我愿永远守护丛林的宁静。

say:21:1012708016:1.text: Witnessing the Lucent Tree come back to life feels like a dream, Magister Merlin.
say:21:1012708016:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，看到流荧树恢复生机，我仿佛做了一场梦。
say:21:1012708016:1.male: Witnessing the Lucent Tree come back to life feels like a dream, Magister Merlin.
say:21:1012708016:1.female: Witnessing the Lucent Tree come back to life feels like a dream, Magister Merlin.

say:22:1012708017:1.text: Although our journey together was full of dangers and tests, it was an honor to travel with you. You have made me stronger.
say:22:1012708017:1.source_cn: 尽管这一路充满艰险与考验，但是能和您一起旅行，我感到十...
say:22:1012708017:1.male: Although our journey together was full of dangers and tests, it was an honor to travel with you. You have made me stronger.
say:22:1012708017:1.female: Although our journey together was full of dangers and tests, it was an honor to travel with you. You have made me stronger.

say:23:1012708018:0.text: When I was at my weakest, you were there to lift me up. I will forever remember what you have taught me.

say:24:1012708019:0.text: Going forward, I will fulfill all my duties as a Dusk Patroller of the Dark Forest.

say:6:1012713006:0.text: I didn't leave the Dark Forest to see the world. All I wanted to do was go out there and find some help for my home.
say:6:1012713006:0.source_cn: 起初，我并不是为了看看这个世界才离开薄暮丛林。我只是想...

say:0:1012714001:0.text: The Dark Forest is fine now. Where are you going next? Holistone?
say:0:1012714001:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林没事了，你们接下来打算去哪？先回圣石镇吗？

say:1:1012714002:0.text: Valen is still waiting for us at the refugee camp. We can't leave him behind.
say:1:1012714002:0.source_cn: 维伦还在难民营地等我们，可不能把他落下。

say:2:1012714003:0.text: Okay, let's go to the refugee camp and then return to Holistone.
say:2:1012714003:0.source_cn: 啊，差点忘了这家伙……去难民营地找他吧，然后大家一起回...

say:1:1012715001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're finally back! How did everything go?

say:3:1012716002:0.text: Okay, I need to set off soon as well. Eironn, when are you planning to leave?
say:3:1012716002:0.source_cn: 好啦，接下来我也该出发了。埃隆，你打算什么时候启程？

say:5:1012716003:0.text: I will stay for a few more days. Lyca just took over handling all the affairs of the Dark Forest. She may need help.
say:5:1012716003:0.source_cn: 我还要再留几天，莱卡刚刚接手薄暮丛林的事务，太忙了，正...

say:6:1012716004:0.text: Aren't you going to say goodbye to Lyca before you leave?
say:6:1012716004:0.source_cn: 你走之前，不打算和莱卡打声招呼吗？

say:7:1012716005:0.text: Like you said, she's busy in her new role. I don't think she has time to worry about me.
say:7:1012716005:0.source_cn: 你都说了她现在忙着呢，哪有时间管我？

choice_prompt:8:1012716005.text: Like you said, she's busy in her new role. I don't think she has time to worry about me.
choice_prompt:8:1012716005.source_cn: 你都说了她现在忙着呢，哪有时间管我？

say:9:1012716006:0.text: Who's scared? I just don't want to disturb her, that's all... I mean, if she really doesn't let me leave, then that would be a problem.
say:9:1012716006:0.source_cn: 这有什么不敢的？我只是不想打扰她嘛……不过，万一她真的...

say:10:1012716008:0.text: Lyca will be upset if you leave without saying goodbye.
say:10:1012716008:0.source_cn: 你不辞而别，莱卡大概会生气。

say:11:1012716009:0.text: Well, if she does get really angry, remember to say a few nice words for me...
say:11:1012716009:0.source_cn: 如果她真的生气了，你记得帮我说两句好话……

say:13:1012716011:0.text: When the wind blows swiftly toward you once more, that's when we'll see each other again!
say:13:1012716011:0.source_cn: 等风儿再度吹向你们的时候——咱们再见！

say:15:1012716007:0.text: It's alright. Don't worry about it. I'll write to her in a few days.
say:15:1012716007:0.source_cn: 咳……总之，先这么定了，我过几天再给她写信。

say:1:1012717001:0.text: Alright, find yourself a comfy spot. We'll be gliding through these waters in no time.
say:1:1012717001:0.source_cn: 好嘞，您坐稳咯，马上启航。
say:1:1012717001:0.male: Alright, find yourself a comfy spot. We'll be gliding through these waters in no time.
say:1:1012717001:0.female: Alright, find yourself a comfy spot. We'll be gliding through these waters in no time.

say:0:1012719001:0.text: Eomir! It's not too late to turn back! Don't do anything you'll regret!
say:0:1012719001:0.source_cn: 伊米尔，现在回头还为时不晚，不要做出让自己后悔的决定。

say:1:1012719002:0.text: It's you who will regret making me your enemy!
say:1:1012719002:0.source_cn: 与我为敌，后悔的应是你们！

subtitle:1:1012707101:.text: Lyca... In the name of Misarte, so do you pledge.
subtitle:1:1012707101:.source_cn: 莱卡，你以弥萨忒之名，在此起誓

subtitle:1:1012707102:.text: Though the rivers may run dry...

subtitle:1:1012707104:.text: Are you willing to lead the forest through dusk till dawn?
subtitle:1:1012707104:.source_cn: 你也愿意指引丛林走向黎明吗？

subtitle:1:1012707106:.text: Till death, I will uphold this vow.

subtitle:1:1012707107:.text: So witnessed by the Lucent Tree,

subtitle:1:1012713103:.text: I've decided to go on a trip
subtitle:1:1012713103:.male: I've decided to go on a trip
subtitle:1:1012713103:.female: I've decided to go on a trip

subtitle:1:1012713104:.text: to listen to every whisper of wind the world has to offer.
subtitle:1:1012713104:.source_cn: 我想……聆听整个世界的风。
subtitle:1:1012713104:.male: to listen to every whisper of wind the world has to offer.
subtitle:1:1012713104:.female: to listen to every whisper of wind the world has to offer.

subtitle:1:1012704104:.text: *Sigh* Test subjects always like to talk.
subtitle:1:1012704104:.source_cn: 唉，实验品的话总是这么多。

subtitle:1:1012705104:.text: A single person cannot protect the forest.
subtitle:1:1012705104:.source_cn: 单凭我的力量确实做不到。

say:5:1012620001:0.text: It's my turn to take watch. You can go ahead and sleep.

say:6:1012620002:0.text: I'm not sleepy. As our most indispensable fighting member, you need more rest than I do.
say:6:1012620002:0.source_cn: 不用，我不困。你作为不可或缺的战力，更需要好好休息。

say:8:1012620004:0.text: Then come sit down and look at the stars. They're beautiful tonight.
say:8:1012620004:0.source_cn: 那你坐下看星星吧，今晚的星星很好看。

say:9:1012620005:0.text: Indeed, the night sky is very clear tonight. The last time I saw such a beautiful sea of stars was decades ago.
say:9:1012620005:0.source_cn: 的确，今夜的星海非常清澈。上次见到这么美丽的星海，似乎...

say:10:1012620006:0.text: The night sky has always been beautiful, but since you started studying swordsmanship, I'm afraid you never had the time to appreciate what was in front of you.
say:10:1012620006:0.source_cn: 星海一直很美，只不过，自从你决心钻研剑术，恐怕，再也没...

say:11:1012620007:0.text: Maybe you're right, Lorsan. You know I admire you sometimes. You and Bryon always say things that make me think... very philosophically.
say:11:1012620007:0.source_cn: 嗯……或许你是对的。洛桑，我很佩服你，你和布莱恩总是能...

say:12:1012620008:0.text: Meanwhile, I'm a lummox who always angers the people around me. At times, I'm not even sure why people get angry with me.
say:12:1012620008:0.source_cn: 而我，嘴笨，总是惹大家生气，还不理解大家为什么生气。

say:13:1012620009:0.text: He and I have been following Master Arden around for so long that we're bound to learn a few things from that old geezer. It's no big deal.
say:13:1012620009:0.source_cn: 我们俩跟了雅顿老师这么久，多多少少被那老爷子影响了。不...

say:14:1012620010:0.text: I envy your sword skills. If I were as strong as you, Lyca wouldn't have gotten hurt...
say:14:1012620010:0.source_cn: 我更羡慕你的剑法，要是我也像你一样强大，莱卡她……不至...

say:15:1012620011:0.text: Does being strong really matter? I've been so confused ever since I've returned to the Dark Forest.
say:15:1012620011:0.source_cn: 强大真的有意义吗？此次回到薄暮丛林，我非常迷茫。

say:16:1012620012:0.text: If I hadn't left, Eomir's plan might not have succeeded, and the Lucent Tree would be fine right now.
say:16:1012620012:0.source_cn: 如果我没有离开，伊米尔的阴谋或许不会得逞，流荧树或许不...

say:17:1012620013:0.text: In the end, I wanted to become stronger to protect everyone, but I failed to protect them. Did I make a mistake in leaving to become a better swordsman?
say:17:1012620013:0.source_cn: 到头来……想要变强然后保护大家的我，没能保护人。我选择...

say:18:1012620014:0.text: If you think like that, what are the rest of us supposed to do? Why don't you try to be more like the magister? Even after losing his memories, he's still very determined to move forward.
say:18:1012620014:0.source_cn: 如果连你都这么想，我们该怎么办啊？你为什么不学学梅林大...
say:18:1012620014:0.male: If you think like that, what are the rest of us supposed to do? Why don't you try to be more like the magister? Even after losing his memories, he's still very determined to move forward.
say:18:1012620014:0.female: If you think like that, what are the rest of us supposed to do? Why don't you try to be more like the magister? Even after losing her memories, she's still very determined to move forward.

say:19:1012620015:0.text: I'm amazed at how calm he always is. I feel like, as long as I'm with him, everything will be alright no matter what situation we encounter.
say:19:1012620015:0.male: I'm amazed at how calm he always is. I feel like, as long as I'm with him, everything will be alright no matter what situation we encounter.
say:19:1012620015:0.female: I'm amazed at how calm she always is. I feel like, as long as I'm with her, everything will be alright no matter what situation we encounter.

say:20:1012620016:0.text: You know what, Eironn? In the past, you also made everyone feel that way. But somehow, after you got stronger, you felt... lost.
say:20:1012620016:0.source_cn: 埃隆，知道吗？过去的你，也曾让大家如此安心。可你变强后...

say:22:1012620018:0.text: Yes, you're right. He doesn't suffer alone. He's, at least, willing to rely on us.
say:22:1012620018:0.male: Yes, you're right. He doesn't suffer alone. He's, at least, willing to rely on us.
say:22:1012620018:0.female: Yes, you're right. She doesn't suffer alone. She's, at least, willing to rely on us.

say:23:1012620019:0.text: Doesn't relying on others mean that you're weak?
say:23:1012620019:0.source_cn: 依靠他人……并不等于软弱吗？

say:24:1012620020:0.text: I've never thought the magister was weak, and I'm not alone. Lyca and Bryon must think the same. How about you?
say:24:1012620020:0.source_cn: 起码，我从不认为梅林大人软弱。不止是我，莱卡和布莱恩一...
say:24:1012620020:0.male: I've never thought the magister was weak, and I'm not alone. Lyca and Bryon must think the same. How about you?
say:24:1012620020:0.female: I've never thought the magister was weak, and I'm not alone. Lyca and Bryon must think the same. How about you?

say:25:1012620021:0.text: I think that he's <style="highlight">a great mage</style>.
say:25:1012620021:0.male: I think that he's <style="highlight">a great mage</style>.
say:25:1012620021:0.female: I think that she's <style="highlight">a great mage</style>.

say:26:1012620022:0.text: Of course, that's THE Magister Merlin.
say:26:1012620022:0.male: Of course, that's THE Magister Merlin.
say:26:1012620022:0.female: Of course, that's THE Magister Merlin.

say:27:1012620023:0.text: And you are Eironn of the Dark Forest!
say:27:1012620023:0.source_cn: 而你，你可是薄暮丛林的埃隆！

say:29:1012620025:0.text: I think I'm starting to understand.

narration:31:1012716:0.text: It's already late at night, but Eironn seems wide awake. He comes over to Lorsan, who is on night duty, and begins chatting with him.
narration:31:1012716:0.source_cn: 已经是深夜了，但埃隆看起来毫无困意，来到值夜的洛桑身边...
